title: AraMIP: Extending MIPVU Towards Metaphor Identification in Arabic
abstract: arXiv:2609.17235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Metaphor research has gained increasing attention due to its relevance to linguistic creativity, language use, cognitive processes, and related areas. While many efforts have been devoted to metaphor identification and annotation in English and other languages, Arabic remains under-resourced in this area. In this work, we propose the Arabic Metaphor Identification Procedure (AraMIP), a novel guideline for Arabic metaphor annotation. AraMIP builds on the widely used Metaphor Identification Procedure Vrije Universiteit (MIPVU) framework, incorporating adaptations that accounts for the language-specific properties of Arabic. We distinguish three major types of Arabic figurative language: Isti'ara (metaphor), kinaya (metonymy/indirect expression), and tashbih (simile), and annotate a pilot dataset of 300 sentences (5277 words). Our analysis reveals key challenges specific to Arabic, including morphological complexity, inconsistencies in dict

translated_title: AraMIP：扩展MIPVU框架以实现阿拉伯语隐喻识别
translated_abstract: 隐喻研究因其与语言创造性、语言使用、认知过程及相关领域的紧密联系而日益受到关注。尽管在英语和其他语言的隐喻识别与标注方面已投入了大量努力，但阿拉伯语在这一领域仍然资源匮乏。在本工作中，我们提出了阿拉伯语隐喻识别程序（AraMIP），这是一套新颖的阿拉伯语隐喻标注指南。AraMIP建立在广泛使用的阿姆斯特丹自由大学隐喻识别程序（MIPVU）框架基础之上，并结合了针对阿拉伯语特有语言属性的适应性调整。我们区分了阿拉伯语修辞性语言的三大主要类型：Isti'ara（隐喻）、kinaya（转喻/间接表达）和tashbih（明喻），并标注了一个包含300个句子（5277个词）的试点数据集。我们的分析揭示了阿拉伯语特有的关键挑战，包括形态复杂性、词典中的不一致性等。
tldr: 提出了AraMIP——一种基于MIPVU框架并针对阿拉伯语语言特性进行适配的阿拉伯语隐喻标注指南，区分了阿拉伯语三大修辞类型并构建了首个阿拉伯语隐喻识别试点数据集。
en_tdlr: Proposed AraMIP, a novel Arabic metaphor annotation guideline that extends the MIPVU framework with Arabic-specific adaptations, distinguishes three major types of Arabic figurative language, and provides a pilot dataset of 300 annotated sentences.
